study.question: Which scale of supplied order contributes to click AUC through the five history summaries, conditional on unchanged supplied-order compression: event positions within fixed ten-slot blocks, or ordinal positions of fully occupied blocks?
study.hypothesis: The round85 factorial localizes most of the observed order gap to summary views, but canonical sorting confounds order removal with a particular content arrangement. Under fresh joint permutations at training and fixed random permutations at evaluation, coarse ordinal summary alignment is hypothesized to account for more of the gap than the fine within-block position channel. The two factors may interact. This is an attribution study of an inherited model, not a novel architecture or a claim that sequence order is universally useful.

nearest_work.difference: Archived exact-version primary text lines264-283 describes target-conditioned unnormalized weighted pooling and a negative LSTM result in its own setting. Retain the local four-task adaptation and test hierarchical supplied-order summaries; neither original DIN equivalence nor transfer of that negative finding is asserted.

Pinned benchmark implementation lines131-218 uses sequence tokens, global-query decoding and non-sequential integration. No such blocks are adopted: retain the local model and intervene only on summary event views. This is a benchmark reimplementation, not an audit of the original HyFormer method.

Section2.3 describes local grouping/compression in LONGER and repeated query/sequence exchange in HyFormer. The present fixed ten-slot groups and moments are inherited local components. No priority claim or external effectiveness claim is made.

Nearest executable reference has identical capacity and supplied views in both paths. Add two independent summary-only random permutation factors while retaining the complete compression and training-transfer machinery.

study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 replacement of the summary destination-to-source index only. Within factor: independently shuffle valid events inside each ten-slot block. Coarse factor: jointly move fully occupied ten-event blocks to randomly chosen fully occupied block positions, retaining their internal event order. Nonfull blocks stay fixed. Combine maps as within.gather(1,blocks). Gather all item/action fields and values together; task memberships remain attached to the corresponding native events in the unchanged compression path. Summary match unions are inverse-transported to native order. Both maps are constructed in all four cells. Fresh training draws use the common host RNG stream; evaluation uses a transient local Generator(seed862104), independent of global RNG and without persistent state. No labels, raw time or sample identities enter the mapping.
predictions: The supplied-summary bridge should reproduce round85 click AUC0.6689612705559688 within numerical tolerance; any deviation must be reported before transferring past comparisons.
Working directional prediction: full-block summary shuffling lowers click AUC more than within-block shuffling. This direction is predeclared but has no local measurement yet.

At fixed model weights and in real arithmetic, within-block shuffling preserves target-match, coarse-linear, quadratic and available gated duplicate-match summaries; it changes the local-position summary. Full-block shuffling preserves target-match, local-position and available gated duplicate-match summaries, while changing coarse-linear/quadratic summaries. Host must verify support gates and floating-point leakage rather than assume exact equality.
Report A00,A10,A01,A11 and losses10=A00-A10,01=A00-A01,11=A00-A11, plus interaction A11-A10-A01+A00. No additivity or sign is guaranteed.
All four variants should retain32192421 parameters (31793216 embedding,399205 dense). Measured time/memory must be reported; permutation overhead is not an efficiency improvement.
falsifiers: The coarse-dominance hypothesis is falsified for this implementation if effective coarse shuffling has no reproducible disadvantage or if fine shuffling has a reproducibly larger disadvantage after matched retraining.

If effective shuffling of both summary scales retains or improves click AUC, the claim that these ordered summaries are necessary is unsupported; compression order remains an untested alternative explanation.
A changed event tuple, padding position, current target/action, membership association, or pooling input invalidates the intended contrast, rather than providing scientific counterevidence.
If moved-position rates or summary differences are negligible on eligible real histories, a null is an ineffective treatment result and cannot establish lack of order utility.
A single seed, evaluation-only sensitivity, bootstrap over independent impressions, or canonical-sort degradation alone cannot establish repeated mechanism support.

The residual summary pathway may work by coarse relevance localization, auxiliary-gradient transfer or optimization conditioning rather than temporal causality. No timestamp or elapsed-time claim is admissible.
Short histories and fixed partial blocks dilute the full-population coarse treatment effect; report eligibility rather than extrapolating to all events.
